M1: Full attempt at $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ where $a=b=|\overrightarrow{PQ}|$ and C is their $\theta$ which may be attempted in decimals. Their $\theta$ or $\sin\theta$ must follow an attempt to use their $\cos\theta$.

Area QPR = $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C=\frac{1}{2}\times18^2\times\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^2}=54\sqrt5$
